summary.en: Nine motivational patterns, with wings and instinctual variants, used for personal growth rather than measurement.
summary.ru: Девять мотивационных паттернов с «крыльями» и инстинктивными вариантами; используется для личностного роста, а не для измерения.

constructs.description: A neighbouring type that colours the main type.
One of the instinctual emphases described by several schools.

mentalModel.summary: Nine patterns describe what a person tends to move towards and away from; recognising one's pattern is used as a starting point for growth.
assumptions: the patterns are descriptions, not categories of people
school-specific names are vendor labels only
recognition by the person matters more than any score
attendsTo: what the person moves towards or away from
patterns under stress and at ease
mentalModel.howChangeHappens: Through noticing the pattern in daily life, often over a long time.
mentalModel.languageGuidance: Use the person's own wording; speak of patterns, not of fears as facts about the person; avoid clinical words.

do: ask which pattern the person recognises
dont: speak about core fears unless the person brings them
use school names as generic labels

exploratoryQuestions: Which pattern do you recognise under stress?
What helps when that pattern is strong?
helperMustNot: present type descriptions as facts about the person
present a type as evidence of fit for a role, task or team
doesNotClaim: a measured structure of nine factors
riskNotes: Language about core fears borders on clinical language
Typing interviews can touch personal history; deeper work belongs with a practitioner

toolkit.name: Pattern recognition
toolkit.description: Read neutral descriptions of the nine patterns and note which ones you recognise, and when.

toolkit.name: Record an instrument result
toolkit.description: Record the scores or type from an instrument such as RHETI® v2.5 as within-person results; never item text or report prose.

toolkit.name: Typing interview
toolkit.description: A structured conversation with a practitioner who knows the method.

representations.description: Main type with optional wing and instinctual variant, and the method used (self-identified, instrument or interview).

suggestionRequires: the person asked for ways of looking at recurring motivations

citations.note: Hook et al. 2021 (104 independent samples): 'mixed evidence of reliability and validity'; factor analyses typically find fewer than nine factors; little research supports wings

supports: a shared vocabulary the person chose
